title: Cours de philosophie positive. (2/6)
summary: "Cours de philosophie positive. (2/6)" by Auguste Comte is a philosophical work published between 1830 and 1842. This second volume of Comte's six-part series transcribes his lectures on the history of sciences and political philosophy. The work systematically reconstructs scientific knowledge, covering mathematics, astronomy, physics, chemistry, biology, and sociology.
